description: This file contains the implementation of the UserDao interface, providing methods to retrieve User entities from the database based on username, ID, and store. It uses Querydsl for constructing type-safe queries within a Spring-managed repository.

classes.name: UserDaoImpl
classes.description: Implements data access methods for User entities, extending generic DAO functionality and providing custom queries to find users by username, ID, and store.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on the provided username, including related groups, merchant store, and default language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a User entity by its unique ID, with associated entities eagerly loaded.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Lists all Users with their associated groups, merchant store, and default language, ordered by user ID.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Lists all Users associated with a specific MerchantStore, ordered by user ID.
